attackers_goals: An attacker is trying to gain code execution on the host.
description: A Microsoft Office process spawned a commonly abused process with a full command (not a script), this is a typically malicious behavior.
investigative_actions: Check whether the command line executed is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it. For example, employees working in finance may have legitimate use cases for complex Excel commands.
name: Microsoft Office Process Spawning a Suspicious One-Liner
